svg.text: After (7ccbb568, R1172 closed): growth optimum. No reaction can take CoA out of the matrix; the nine stay at 0
Arrows: blue = carries flux in this solution (minimum total flux or pFBA); grey = 0. Arrows point in the drawn route direction; "AGAINST the arrow" marks the opposite sign.
Not drawn: the cytosolic HMG-CoA route R82 + R411 (feeds R410 when R1172 is closed), the TCA cycle and the supply of oxaloacetate, threonine and isoleucine.
